name: Furusaka Aya
source: Mysterious girl that appeared when [url=/c6130]Yuuya[/url] returned to the town. Doesn't remember who she is or where she came from. Very energetic, quickly became attached to Yuuya and became a little sister for him. Has the powers of "Shinsou" (soul performance) and "Shinwan" (divine arm).
